senses.zh_definition: 在姓名语境中，Chen 通常是汉语姓氏的罗马字拼写，常对应“陈／陳”；本输入未提供具体人物或汉字，故不能确定其唯一所指。
senses.en_definition: In personal names, a romanized Chinese surname, commonly corresponding to 陈 or 陳; the intended identity is unspecified here.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam konteks nama orang, ejaan Rumi bagi nama keluarga Cina yang lazimnya sepadan dengan aksara 陈 atau 陳; identiti khusus tidak dinyatakan dalam input.
senses.nuances: 本条暂按常见姓氏解释，不宣称 chen 是已核实的标准马来语普通词。Chen 通常对应陈姓，但其他姓氏也可能采用这一拼法。以下搭配是称谓示例，不是已验证的高频词汇搭配；马来语释义为编辑性说明。[Chen 的姓氏资料](https://www.familysearch.org/en/surname?surname=chen)

etymology.historical_story: When Chen represents 陳 or 陈, one traditional surname origin connects it with the ancient state of Chen in China. Other historical origins and other underlying characters also occur. Malaysian heritage documentation lists Chen alongside spellings such as Tan and Chan, illustrating how different language varieties can produce different registered forms of a surname. [Surname history](https://www.familysearch.org/en/surname?surname=chen), [Malaysian surname spellings](https://gtwhi.com.my/wp-content/uploads/2019/04/A-Guide-to-Selected-Chinese-Clan-Houses-English.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 若本人确认姓“陈”，就把 Chen 与汉语拼音 Chén 配对；先认人名，再记读音，不按马来语拼写规则硬读。
